record.dic_text:
0271 'Achaz {a:-kha:z'}

源自 0270; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Ahaz 41; 41

亞哈斯 = "他已掌握"
1) 猶大王約坦的兒子, 希西家的父親
2) 便雅憫人, 米迦的兒子, 約拿單的曾孫
record.edic_text:
0271 'Achaz {aw-khawz'}

from 0270;; n pr m

AV - Ahaz 41; 41

Ahaz = "he has grasped"
1) king of Judah, son Jotham, father of Hezekiah
2) a Benjamite, son of Micah, and great grandson of Jonathan
